preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first section must either be '-1' or contain n-1 lines, each with 2 space-separated integers representing edges of a tree.
The second section must either be '-1' or contain n-1 lines, each with 2 space-separated integers representing edges of a tree.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split('\n')[0] == '-1' or len(set(map(tuple, (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:int(stdin.split()[0])])))) == int(stdin.split()[0]) - 1
postconditions.description: If the first section is not '-1', it must represent a tree with n-1 unique edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split('\n')[int(stdin.split()[0])].strip() == '-1' or len(set(map(tuple, (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdout.split('\n')[int(stdin.split()[0])+1:])))) == int(stdin.split()[0]) - 1
postconditions.description: If the second section is not '-1', it must represent a tree with n-1 unique edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split('\n')[0] == '-1' or all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:int(stdin.split()[0])] for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: If the first section is not '-1', all node numbers in the edges must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split('\n')[int(stdin.split()[0])].strip() == '-1' or all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split('\n')[int(stdin.split()[0])+1:] for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: If the second section is not '-1', all node numbers in the edges must be between 1 and n inclusive.
If the first section is not '-1', the second section must also not be '-1'.
